answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: decay reward exponentially within a correlated cluster. Group accounts by detected correlation; the k-th member earns reward times one-half to the (k-1), so a cluster's total payout converges to a bounded sum however many join. One genuine account keeps a full pearl; a fleet of raven-identical clones splits a geometric series summing to near one share. The thousandth fake earns nothing, so breadth drowns in its own cluster like stones in a lagoon. An attacker cannot out-earn by multiplying: correlated identities share one fading pool, not a thousand full ones.
